<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Reject a Draft plan"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/slot-plans/{planId}/reject"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Moves a `Draft` plan to `Rejected` and publishes `SlotPlanRejected`. The
optional `reason` is at most 500 characters. Rejecting a plan that is not
a `Draft` is a 409 `plan-not-draft`.


<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

>
  
</ParamsDetails>

>
